jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp458_box.1: SCP-458, The Never-Ending Pizza Box, is a square cardboard box printed in orange and red. Whenever its lid is lifted it holds a whole, hot pizza cut into six slices.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp458_box.2: Use the box to lift the lid and use the open box to take a slice. Sneak and use it, or use the raised lid, to close it. Once the lid has been closed and lifted again, the pizza inside is whole. It can be carried and opened in the hand as well.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp458_box.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-458 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A stranger in Foundation dress will bring the box to you, closed.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp458_slice.1: A slice of pizza from SCP-458. It is ordinary food in every way, and it stays fresh.

dossier.scp_unleashed.458.title: The Never-Ending Pizza Box
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.caption: SCP-458 at intake with its lid raised, beside a scale rule. The contents were eaten after the photograph was taken.
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.0.text.0: SCP-458 is kept closed in a standard storage locker in the Site cafeteria annex, at room temperature. It requires no feeding, cleaning or maintenance.
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.0.text.1: Personnel may request SCP-458 for meals during extended operations with the approval of the shift supervisor. Every opening and every slice removed is to be logged. **The lid is to be closed again after use.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.0.text.2: SCP-458 is not to be cut, soaked or flattened. %rTesting of its limits is suspended until the cafeteria staff stop asking about it.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.1.text.0: SCP-458 is a square pizza box of corrugated cardboard, roughly forty centimetres on a side and five centimetres deep. The lid is printed in orange and red with a cartoon slice of pizza, and a row of tick boxes runs along the front edge, none of them filled in. The print carries no name, address or telephone number.
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.1.text.1: Whenever the lid is lifted, SCP-458 holds a whole, hot pizza cut into six slices. The pizza is always freshly baked and at a temperature fit for eating. Slices removed from the box are ordinary food in every respect, and they keep as well as any other.
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.1.text.2: Slices are not replaced while the lid stays open. Once the lid has been closed and lifted again, the pizza inside is whole.
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.1.text.3: The kind of pizza found inside has varied between tests. %rThe factor that decides it has been identified and is withheld from this file.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.2.title: Addendum 458-1: Test Log
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.2.text.0: Test 458-01: a researcher lifted the lid. Inside was a whole pepperoni pizza, steaming, cut into six slices. The researcher was allowed one slice and described it as excellent.
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.2.text.1: Test 458-03: all six slices were removed and the lid was closed. When the lid was lifted again, the pizza was whole.
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.2.text.2: Test 458-05: D-9312 lifted the lid. Inside was a pizza with pineapple and ham. Asked to describe it, D-9312 grinned and would not stop talking. %rInterview transcript withheld.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.2.text.3: Test 458-06: a second researcher took a slice while D-9312 held the lid. %rResult withheld.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.2.text.4: Test 458-08: the box was sealed in a cabinet with a remote arm rigged to lift the lid. The lid would not move. It has not moved for any machine since.
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.3.title: Addendum 458-2: Note
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.3.text: Found tucked under the front flap at intake, on a paper slip: THANK YOU FOR YOUR ORDER. The order number and the name on the slip have been %rcut away%r.
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.4.title: Addendum 458-3: Provenance
dossier.scp_unleashed.458.page.4.text: SCP-458 has no recovery record. It was delivered to a reader of this file. See field notes.
